thread:
maria: Heads-up — I'm seeing steady memory growth in the KV cache on long-context runs (50k+ tokens). Heap snapshots and jemalloc stats suggest fragmentation rather than an actual leak. Repro: `./tools/kv_repro.py --ctx 50000 --repeat 20`.

kevin: I noticed this too after the allocator switch last month (commit abc123). Seems like many small free extents and the allocator is failing to coalesce.

sanjay: Pasted a short jemalloc snapshot from the repro run:

```
arenas: 4
mapped: 6.3 GiB
allocated: 3.9 GiB
active: 4.5 GiB
metadata: 120 MiB
retained: 1.4 GiB
--- extent fragmentation ---
small_extents: 4123
large_extents: 87
avg_free_run: 6.4KB
max_contiguous: 48KB
```

infra-bot: Deploy note: rolling runtime deploy on infra-stage at 2024-07-15T14:32Z (no incidents).

olivia: Two quick hypotheses: (1) our KV block allocator uses fairly small fixed blocks which leads to internal fragmentation for long KV chains, (2) pointer metadata and freelist nodes are not being reclaimed/merged efficiently.

jun: Proposed quick compaction idea — background coalescing thread that scans freed blocks and attempts to merge adjacent free runs when fragmentation_ratio > threshold. Pseudocode:

```
while (running) {
  sleep(compaction_interval)
  if (fract_ratio() < 0.25) continue
  for (zone in hot_zones()) {
    lock(zone)
    scan_free_runs(zone) -> candidates
    merge_adjacent(candidates)
    release_locks
  }
}
```

maria: Notes from a couple of microbench runs: doing sync compaction on the main path reduces fragmentation but causes p99 token latency to spike ~8%. Background compaction with low-priority threads reduces fragmentation with ~1% p99 overhead. Suggest heuristic: only compact when fragmentation > 0.25 AND CPU_idle > 30%.

kevin: Also worth considering tuning the block size distribution: move to power-of-two bins, and increase baseline slab from 4KB -> 16KB or 64KB for long-context workloads. That should reduce the number of extents and make coalescing easier. We should benchmark memory amplification vs. internal waste.

sanjay: Quick perf summary from today's runs (32k context, batch=1, A100):

```
baseline (no compaction):         10.2k tokens/s, mem 5.1GiB, frag_ratio=0.31
sync compaction on alloc path:    9.4k tokens/s, mem 4.2GiB, frag_ratio=0.08
bg compaction thread:             10.1k tokens/s, mem 4.3GiB, frag_ratio=0.10
power-of-two bins + 64KB slab:    10.0k tokens/s, mem 4.0GiB, frag_ratio=0.07
```

olivia: I'll add the following metrics to the console: `kv.frag_ratio`, `kv.free_runs`, `kv.max_contiguous_bytes`, `kv.compaction_pauses_ms`, and expose a `kv.compaction_mode` tag (off/bg/sync). Those should help ops decide rollout.
